GrapesJS 0.23.6 (https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs), BSD 3-Clause License: see LICENSE.
Unchanged copy of dist/grapes.min.js and dist/css/grapes.min.css from the npm package grapesjs@0.23.6,
without the source map comment.

GrapesJS Preset Newsletter 1.0.2 (https://github.com/GrapesJS/preset-newsletter), BSD 3-Clause License:
see LICENSE-preset-newsletter. grapesjs-preset-newsletter.min.js is dist/index.js from the npm package
grapesjs-preset-newsletter@1.0.2 (with juice, which puts the styles inline), without the source map comment.

Font Awesome 4.7.0 (https://fontawesome.io): the font under the SIL OFL 1.1, the CSS under the MIT License
(see the header of font-awesome.min.css). font-awesome.min.css is css/font-awesome.min.css from the npm
package font-awesome@4.7.0 with only the WOFF2 and WOFF fonts, its rules kept to the editor (.gjs-editor),
so they do not change the administrator's own icons. fonts/ holds those two fonts, unchanged.

Nothing here loads anything from another site: the editor's icons are these, not a CDN's.
